ArkTrace accessibility walkthrough v1
check: focusRestoration
candidateTreeSHA256: 35588b227cb1a929a97a0da186ab621910b2b0e67059b9a614f21aae7a0a6b01
reviewedAt: 2026-08-14T04:12:56Z
reviewMethod: independent-agent-review
steps:
1. Launched the exact Developer ID signed candidate with its real German localization selected and loaded zlib.htrace.
2. In macOS Accessibility > Display > Text Size, changed the preferred reading size from Default (value 4) to 14 pt (value 6).
3. Resized the real ArkTrace window to its supported minimum, keyboard-focused Hide Inspector, and activated it with Space.
4. Verified the first responder became the localized Show Inspector disclosure, then activated it with Space and verified focus moved to the localized Hide Inspector control.
5. Restored the preferred reading size to Default and removed the per-App German language override after the capture.
observations:
- The complete German title "Informationsbereich wieder einblenden" remained visible and keyboard focused at the supported minimum; it was not truncated, overlapped, or moved into toolbar overflow.
- The minimum-window artifact is a 941 by 758 pixel, 72 dpi capture made while the 14 pt macOS preferred reading size was active.
- Manual collapse moved focus directly to the only control that could restore the hidden pane; no extra Tab was required.
- Manual expansion moved focus to "Informationsbereich ausblenden" in the rematerialized Inspector pane.
- All temporary language and preferred-reading-size settings were restored to their original state.
